pictures.scene: Aert de Gelder, Jacob's Dream — the whole country gone brown and dark under a heavy night sky with one break of gold light torn open high on the right, a white winged angel coming down out of that brightness with its wings spread wide and another burning brighter still above it, bare thin trees leaning on the near slope, and Jacob asleep on the ground at the bottom with his head laid on the stone, after this I looked, and there before me was a door standing open in heaven
pictures.name: pd_de_gelder_jacobs_dream

pictures.scene: Albrecht Durer, The Seven Angels with the Trumpets — God the Father enthroned in a burst of rays at the top of the sheet giving out the long straight trumpets to the seven angels crowded round Him, another angel swinging a censer over the draped altar below, the first blasts already falling as fire and hail on the sea with ships breaking up in the waves and a burning mountain going down among them, a walled town on the far shore, and the artist's monogram cut in at the foot, and the voice I had previously heard speak to me like a trumpet was saying
pictures.name: pd_durer_the_seven_angels_with_the_trumpets

pictures.scene: Thirteenth-century Apocalypse manuscript, The Vision of the Throne and the Elders — John standing out in the margin with his halo and his hand raised toward the vision, Christ enthroned inside a green almond in the middle of the page with the cross staff in one hand and the written book held open in the other, winged creatures set at the corners of the frame, the crowned elders seated in rows on both sides with their harps and their viols, and two columns of Latin below in black and red with painted initials, come up here, and I will show you what must happen after these things
pictures.name: pd_apocalypse_vision_of_the_throne_and_elders

pictures.scene: Albrecht Durer, Saint John before God and the Elders — God enthroned high in the clouds with the seven burning candlesticks set round Him and the Lamb standing up at His knee, the four winged creatures beneath the throne, the crowned elders ringed all the way round in the cloud with their crowns and their viols, one of them leading John forward on his knees in the middle of the sheet, and a wide earthly country opening below with a town, a castle on the water and trees, at once I was in the Spirit, and I saw a throne standing in heaven
pictures.name: pd_durer_saint_john_before_god_and_the_elders

pictures.scene: Sant Climent de Taull, Christ Pantocrator — the painted figure filling the apse inside a blue mandorla, one hand raised in blessing with two fingers up and the other holding the open book that reads I am the light of the world, the long face straight on with wide dark eyes and a parted beard, the robes falling in white and green folds with red and gold borders, and the bare feet set down on the lower rim, with someone seated on it, the One seated there looked like jasper and carnelian
pictures.name: pd_taull_pantocrator

pictures.scene: Frederic Edwin Church, Rainy Season in the Tropics — a double rainbow thrown clean across the whole gorge from one wall to the other, the mist still lying in the valley underneath it, a snow peak standing far off above the cloud, tall palms and thick wet green crowding the ridge in front, and two small travellers with a laden mule fording the stream at the very bottom, and a rainbow that gleamed like an emerald encircled the throne
pictures.name: pd_church_rainbow

pictures.scene: Thirteenth-century Apocalypse manuscript, The Elders Enthroned — an angel sounding a long trumpet over the seated John at the top of the page, the elders kneeling and bowing in two groups on either side of him, Christ blessing with the open book inside a pointed mandorla in the middle, angels leaning out of blue cloud bands, and the Latin text written below in black and red with two painted initials, surrounding the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and on these thrones sat twenty-four elders
pictures.name: pd_apocalypse_elders_enthroned

pictures.scene: Albrecht Durer, The Adoration of the Lamb — the Lamb standing with its banner inside a ring of light at the top of the sheet with the roundels of the four creatures set about it, the crowned elders pressing in on both edges with their crowns held up, the chosen crowded below in long robes with palm branches in their hands, a city and the open sea at the foot of the picture, and the artist's monogram cut into the ground, dressed in white, with golden crowns on their heads
pictures.name: pd_durer_the_adoration_of_the_lamb

pictures.scene: Martin Johnson Heade, Approaching Thunderstorm — a black roll of storm cloud shut right down over the bay with one thin fork of lightning dropping out of it, the water underneath gone flat and almost black, a man in a straw hat alone in a little rowing boat out on it, a furled white sail laid over a rock in the foreground, and a strip of yellow sand with the far shore and its white houses beyond, from the throne came flashes of lightning, rumblings, and peals of thunder
pictures.name: pd_heade_approaching_thunderstorm

pictures.scene: Albrecht Durer, The Vision of the Seven Candlesticks — the Son of Man sitting up in the clouds in a blaze of rays with the seven stars held out in His right hand and the two-edged sword coming out of His mouth, the open book lying on His knees, the tall branched candlesticks burning on their stands all round Him, John fallen flat on his face at His feet, and the artist's monogram cut in at the bottom, before the throne burned seven torches of fire, these are the seven spirits of God
pictures.name: pd_durer_the_vision_of_the_seven_candlesticks

pictures.scene: Caspar David Friedrich, Moonrise over the Sea — three people seen from behind sitting still on the great rounded boulders at the edge of the water, two women in dark cloaks with one skirt showing red and a man in a blue cap beside them, the moon just risen and small over a sea lying so flat that it holds a long silver track, two sailing ships standing in toward the shore, and bands of violet and gold laid right across the sky, and before the throne was something like a sea of glass, as clear as crystal
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_moonrise_over_the_sea

pictures.scene: Thirteenth-century Apocalypse manuscript, The Lamb and the Four Living Creatures — the Lamb standing on the draped altar inside a pointed almond in the middle of the page with the cross banner beside it and seven eyes set in its head, the four winged creatures at the corners of the frame with the eagle among them, the crowned elders seated in four blocks round the vision with harps and viols in their hands, and the Latin commentary written out below in black and red with painted initials, in the center, around the throne, were four living creatures covered with eyes in front and back
pictures.name: pd_apocalypse_lamb_four_living_creatures

pictures.scene: Rosa Bonheur, Head of a Lion — the lion's head filling nearly the whole picture against a plain blue sky, the heavy mane brushed out in gold and brown all round it, the brow drawn down over two steady amber eyes, the muzzle greyed and marked, the long white whiskers standing out on both sides, and the pale fur under the chin, the first living creature was like a lion, the second like a calf
pictures.name: pd_bonheur_leeuw

pictures.scene: Bruno Liljefors, Sea Eagles — one eagle dropping in out of a grey sky with its wings raked right back and its claws already open, another down on the water with its wings spread over the fish it has taken, the swell running dark green and white underneath them, and the pale hard eye of the falling bird fixed on what is below it, the third had a face like a man, and the fourth was like an eagle in flight
pictures.name: pd_liljefors_sea_eagles

pictures.scene: Book of Kells, The Four Evangelist Symbols — one page divided into four panels, the winged man in the first, the eagle in the second, and the winged ox and the winged lion in the other two, every panel shut in by thick Celtic interlace in gold, green and dark red, and a plain dark cross standing where the four of them meet, and each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and within
pictures.name: pd_kells_four_evangelist_symbols

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, The Singing Angels — eight angels pressed close together round a carved wooden lectern, in heavy red and gold brocade copes with jewelled clasps at the throat and jewelled bands set in their hair, every mouth open on a different note and every face strained with the singing, one hand laid flat on the lectern beside the open book, and a small carved Saint Michael in the panel underneath, day and night they never stop saying, holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_singing_angels

pictures.scene: Daphni Monastery, Christ Pantocrator — the mosaic figure set in gold tesserae and seen from the chest up, the long dark face straight on with heavy brows and wide fixed eyes, the hair and beard falling in dark locks on either side, one hand raised in blessing and the other holding the jewelled book against Him, and the gold ground running out all round to the rim, who was and is and is to come
pictures.name: pd_daphni_christ_pantocrator

pictures.scene: Matthias Grunewald, The Concert of Angels — the angels making music under the great carved and gilded canopy, one kneeling right at the front in white with a viol held across his knee and his face turned up, another behind him in a rose robe drawing the bow across a second viol, a gold angel and a dark feathered one playing back in the shadow, and small haloed heads crowding up into the blue dark above them, and whenever the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks
pictures.name: pd_grunewald_angel_consort

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Christ in Glory — Christ seated inside a deep blue oval ring set with winged heads, in a pale blue robe with the gold cross halo behind Him, one hand raised and the other open, gold rays going out from Him across the whole ground, an angel standing below with the cross held upright, and the saints and the crowned ranks of heaven gathered in close on either side with their hands pressed together, to the One seated on the throne who lives forever and ever
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_christ_in_glory

pictures.scene: Thirteenth-century Apocalypse manuscript, The Elders Pay Homage — Christ enthroned inside a tall pointed frame in the middle of the page with the written book held open in one hand and a small gold cross in the other, angels kneeling in painted bands above Him, the crowned elders pressing in from both sides and stooping right down to lay their gold crowns on the ground in front of Him, a harp set down among them, and the Latin text in two columns below in black and red, the twenty-four elders fall down before the One seated on the throne
pictures.name: pd_apocalypse_elders_pay_homage

pictures.scene: Jan Gossaert, The Adoration of the Kings — one of the kings standing in a gold brocade robe with a jewelled crown on his head and a tall gold vessel held up in his covered hand, a young attendant in front of him in a red cap and a patterned tunic with his eyes cast down, two more men of the train close in behind them, a brick and stone wall going up at the back with a bare window in it, and heavy cloth hung from the roof above, and they worship Him who lives forever and ever, they cast their crowns before the throne, saying
pictures.name: pd_gossaert_the_kings_retinue

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, The Adoration of the Mystic Lamb — the panels of the altarpiece shown one above the other, God enthroned in the middle in a red mantle with a jewelled crown and a crystal sceptre and His hand raised, the Virgin reading at one side of Him and John the Baptist with his open book at the other, and below them the wide green meadow where the Lamb stands on the draped altar with the blood running into the cup, angels kneeling close round it with the cross and the pillar, and the apostles, the popes, the martyrs and the virgins coming in from every corner toward the fountain, worthy are You, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_the_adoration_of_the_mystic_lamb

pictures.scene: Albert Bierstadt, Among the Sierra Nevada — the whole middle of the picture filled with white light breaking through the cloud at the head of the valley, a snow peak standing up sharp above the mist on the right, the sheer walls going down to a still lake that holds every rock upside down, a thin waterfall coming off the cliff, dark pines and oaks crowded along the near shore, and a small herd of deer standing in the shallows and on the bank, for You created all things, by Your will they exist and were created
pictures.name: pd_bierstadt_among_the_sierra_nevada

lines.text: After this I looked, and there before me
was a door standing open in heaven.
And the voice I had previously heard
speak to me like a trumpet was saying,
Come up here, and I will show you
what must happen after these things.
At once I was in the Spirit,
and I saw a throne standing in heaven,
with someone seated on it.
The One seated there looked like jasper and carnelian,
and a rainbow that gleamed like an emerald
encircled the throne.
Surrounding the throne were twenty-four other thrones,
and on these thrones sat twenty-four elders
dressed in white,
with golden crowns on their heads.
From the throne came flashes of lightning,
rumblings, and peals of thunder.
Before the throne burned seven torches of fire.
These are the seven spirits of God.
And before the throne was something
like a sea of glass, as clear as crystal.
In the center, around the throne, were four living creatures
covered with eyes in front and back.
The first living creature was like a lion,
the second like a calf,
the third had a face like a man,
and the fourth was like an eagle in flight.
And each of the four living creatures had six wings
and was covered with eyes all around and within.
Day and night they never stop saying:
Holy, Holy, Holy is the Lord God Almighty,
who was and is
and is to come!
And whenever the living creatures
give glory, honor, and thanks
to the One seated on the throne
who lives forever and ever,
the twenty-four elders fall down
before the One seated on the throne,
and they worship Him who lives forever and ever.
They cast their crowns before the throne, saying:
Worthy are You, our Lord and God,
to receive glory and honor and power,
for You created all things;
by Your will they exist and were created.
